notes: πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων follows rule 80: the single *Whosoever* goes to the quantifier, the substantival article is left unrepresented, and the participle keeps its own verb. A reference comparison will report the empty article as a disagreement; that report is not a correction.
*shall be put to shame* heads on *shame*, the meaning-bearing complement of the support frame (rule 17).
